answers.core: Scrolling is a primary function, and it's not been documented anywhere why as to why horizontal scrolling has been mapped to "Move CanvasItem".
answers.workaround: It looks like it's possible to rewrite the BUTTON_WHEEL_LEFT/BUTTON_WHEEL_RIGHT code to mimic the vertical direction. However, I'm not certain if this is a bug or a feature as the existing code seems to imply that the button wheel *should* be able to pan horizontally.

title: Horizontal Scrolling linked to "Move CanvasItem" instead of "Scroll To Pan"
